approved_scope: Owner requested every integrated unit and item to have a cost, accepting estimates, on 24 October 2026.
historical_rule: Copy an available same-family catalog series; otherwise backcast the replacement model with CPI to the configured FOC/IOC year. Interpolate between CPI anchors. Without a year use 2026 and explicitly label that basis; do not invent an IOC date.
uncertainty_rule: Model ranges are gameplay sensitivity bands, not statistical confidence intervals. General fallback: half to twice the central replacement estimate; future/fictional designs: quarter to four times.
